requirement.description: Fix pickling issues with module objects in simulation contexts. Multiple CRC tests fail with "TypeError: cannot pickle 'module' object" indicating that module objects are being serialized when they shouldn't be.
requirement.contract: Ensure that simulation objects properly handle serialization and deserialization without attempting to pickle module objects. The fix should prevent module instances from being included in serialization processes.

requirement.description: Fix callability issues with Delay, Tick, and other trigger objects. Tests fail with "TypeError: 'X' object is not callable" indicating these objects are being called incorrectly.
requirement.contract: Ensure that Delay, Tick, and other trigger objects properly implement their interfaces and are not being invoked as functions when they should be used as objects in async operations.

requirement.description: Fix async iteration protocol issues with triggers. Tests fail with "'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method" indicating missing async iteration support in trigger objects.
requirement.contract: Ensure that trigger objects properly implement the async iteration protocol (__aiter__, __anext__) so they can be used correctly in async for loops.

requirement.description: Fix missing or undefined names in trigger implementations. One test fails with "NameError: name 'BrokenTrigger' is not defined" suggesting missing imports or definitions.
requirement.contract: Ensure all referenced classes and exceptions (like BrokenTrigger) are properly imported and available in the simulation module namespace.

requirement.description: Fix assertion failures in reset and edge detection logic. Tests fail with assertion errors showing incorrect values, likely due to timing or logic issues in reset handling and edge detection.
requirement.contract: Correct the simulation logic for reset handling and edge detection to produce expected values according to test assertions.
